events.description: A large group of people is engaged in violent unrest on a city street, with multiple individuals throwing objects and smoke/tear gas visible throughout the scene; police or security forces appear to be present in the background, and civilians are fleeing or reacting to the chaos.

A bright flash and expanding smoke plume consistent with a small explosion or detonation (e.g., a stun grenade or tear gas canister discharge) occurs near the center-left of the frame at ~1.0–1.5 s, with visible fire/sparks and rapid smoke expansion.

Two individuals in the mid-ground appear to engage in physical confrontation: one raises arms while another moves aggressively toward them amid smoke; motion blur suggests active grappling or striking.

A large cloud of white smoke or tear gas rapidly expands across a city street, obscuring visibility and causing people to flee or take cover; uniformed personnel are visible in the background, and individuals are seen running or shielding themselves, consistent with crowd dispersal during civil unrest.

A large cloud of white smoke or tear gas rapidly expands across a city street, obscuring visibility; multiple individuals are seen running away from the source, and uniformed personnel appear in formation further down the street, consistent with crowd control during civil unrest.

A large-scale violent clash between riot police (in helmets and protective gear) and a crowd of protesters in an urban square; smoke (likely tear gas or stun grenades) is deployed, and both sides are actively moving, pushing, and engaging in physical confrontation across multiple frames.

Multiple individuals—including police and protesters—are engaged in direct physical combat: grappling, striking, and shoving, especially visible in close-up frames (e.g., f13–f15) where officers in white helmets physically restrain or strike individuals.

Large-scale violent clash between riot police (in white helmets and dark uniforms) and a group of civilians in an urban square; smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) is visible, and both sides are engaged in dynamic physical confrontation including pushing, shoving, and running toward/away from each other across multiple frames.

Close-range physical combat observed between individuals: officers and protesters are seen grappling, striking, and wrestling near the metal barrier (e.g., frame f5 shows an officer swinging a baton while others engage in hand-to-hand contact; frames f10–f15 show intensified melee with multiple people locked in struggle).

Large group of riot police in helmets and protective gear advancing and engaging with civilians in a public square; multiple individuals are seen running, falling, or being subdued; crowd is visibly agitated and dispersing under police pressure.

A person in civilian clothing is on the ground near a low barrier while a helmeted officer stands over them; in subsequent frames (f12–f13), the officer appears to deploy a spray (likely tear gas or pepper spray) directly at the prone individual, who is crouched and covering their face — indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

In frames f1–f2, two individuals (one in dark jacket, one in lighter top) appear to engage in physical struggle near a metal railing, with one pushing or striking the other; motion blur suggests active mutual combat, though resolution limits certainty.

A riot police officer in white helmet and dark uniform is seen spraying a chemical agent (likely tear gas or pepper spray) directly at a seated or crouching person on the ground, who appears defenseless and is being targeted while others are nearby.

Sustained violent unrest: multiple riot police officers in helmets advance and deploy chemical agents against civilians in a public square; civilians scatter, some fall or crouch, and there is visible crowd agitation and confrontation across the sequence.

Multiple individuals in dark clothing are seen running, throwing objects (e.g., at f1, f2), and engaging in aggressive movement amid a cloud of white smoke or gas (visible from f2 onward). A person is seen mid-leap over a barrier (f6), suggesting evasion or escalation. The scene indicates collective violent unrest with projectile use and dispersal tactics.

Wide shots show a large group of people moving rapidly down a street, with multiple police officers in white helmets and riot gear advancing or forming lines. Debris is visible on the ground, and the crowd appears agitated and dispersed, consistent with an ongoing riot or violent confrontation.

A large group of people, including individuals in riot gear (white helmets, dark uniforms), are advancing down a street while facing a crowd of civilians; objects appear to be thrown (e.g., visible debris/missiles in air at f10–f12), and the scene shows dynamic confrontation with movement toward each other and dispersal patterns consistent with violent unrest.
